name: web-terminal-style-cybersecurity-hero-with-fingerprint-and-stat-tiles
title: Black monospace cybersecurity hero with corner brackets, green CTA, glitchy fingerprint image and stat tiles
whatItIs: A black page in a grey frame with bracketed nav, monospace uppercase headline 'COMPREHENSIVE CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS DESIGNED FOR EVERY DIGITAL BUSINESS', a green tag, green and outlined buttons, a scanned white fingerprint image, partner logos and four dark green stat tiles (99%, 60+, 120+, 24/7).
whatItMeans: Technical and secure; monospace and neon green feel like a terminal.
techniques: Use monospace headlines and corner brackets.
Render the hero as a noisy fingerprint scan.
Use one neon green for actions.
End with a row of stat tiles.

vocabulary.definition: A noisy image resembling a scan.
A dark tile with one big figure.
